steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 13
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: We waited in line for twenty minutes.
We split the house chores every week.
Can you take out the trash tonight?

steps.text: It means: "To go to bed.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I'm exhausted, I'm going to hit the sack.
